trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks itself the moment the other 54 trophies are in your collection. Work through the story, the 100% checklist and every side goal in this guide; most players need around 200 hours in total.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy comes naturally in the first hour.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Keep playing the story missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's final cutscene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story missions only, so just follow the chapter through to its end.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing its story missions in order until the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the last full chapter before the finale, by playing its missions in order.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Every chapter has to be complete before it unlocks, so this is one of the last story trophies you will earn.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It appears during the story, so keep following the mission markers until it is done.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. It is a main-story heist, so it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is part of the main story, so it comes up on its own as you play.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport mission in the main story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory when the story brings it up.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which means finishing every story mission, side activity and collectible the game's 100% checklist tracks. It is the longest grind in the game at roughly 200 hours, so follow the roadmap in this guide and clear it stage by stage.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts all count. There are 397 stunts in total and the 100% checklist wants 300 of them, so mix the types as you travel instead of grinding one spot.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games, bowling, pool, mini golf and basketball. One try at each is enough — you do not need to win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range has several weapon challenges; learn the target patterns, use the right weapon for each lane, and replay any challenge you miss until it turns gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so work through them one by one and learn the gates before you push for speed. The 42 drone time trials count toward 100% too, so run them while you are already at each location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 races in total and the 100% checklist wants 30 won, so keep entering new events rather than repeating one you already won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, take his challenge, and out-fish him by landing the bigger catch.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to end. Any arcade cabinet in Leonida counts — pick the game you find easiest and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Keep doing Andy's missions whenever they appear until his storyline closes.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's final mission. Work through Kenton's missions in order until his last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Billy's missions unlock as you progress, so keep checking back until his story ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for a stranger you meet in the open world, and the five named side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward the eight — finish every strand to the end.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's missions through until his storyline is complete.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Complete Tyrone's missions in order until the last one is done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida with Jason and Lucia. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy flagged as such: the first spot is Lucia meditating on the balcony at Jason's house, offered after the mission Down to Earth in Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends, or it is gone for this playthrough. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18 spots, but the trophy needs all 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's lead to the animal's territory, track it down and take the shot. Bret also has 15 Target Deck objectives that count toward 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of each kind and the trophy pops on the third completed set. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting well past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Find the WAiNK spots around the map and use them one by one until you reach 100. Scanning also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles discovered.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 Challenges. Challenges cover racing, combat, driving and more; the counter adds up across all of them, so keep doing the ones you are best at. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so keep going after this one pops.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up together, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route between three nearby shops, keep the robberies quick, and stay ahead of the police between each one.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive anything new you see — cars, bikes, boats and aircraft all add to the count once you have sat in them. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning everything new you meet.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies with a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies together first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it runs out — a gang hideout is a good place to try.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport. Take a plane from the airport without following the usual departure — steal one and get airborne.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and take it into a fight. Rhinos are the army's tanks; find one at a military site, climb in and use it in combat.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The large vaults open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission called That's Where The Money Is — crack five of the eight vaults and get away clean each time. All eight count toward 100%.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, break it open, take the money and lose the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map fills in as you visit each named area, so drive, fly and walk into every corner of the state.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find one operation per gang, hit it and get out — nine gangs, nine robberies. There are 39 gang operations in total for the 100% checklist, so keep going after this one.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is not confirmed publicly yet — no guide has pinned down which bar or spot starts it — so check the cited sources for the latest reports before you go looking.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger yet, so treat this as unconfirmed and check the cited sources for updates instead of trusting unverified claims.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and take the three key valuables kept there, then escape with them. It is a theft, not a game of bowling — the alley itself is the target.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build up the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia until each one is maxed out. Train strength with both characters — gym work and physical activity raise it — and the trophy pops when both hit the top.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Keep making choices that feed your Criminal Profile — crimes, robberies and mayhem all add to the count, which PlayStation tracks toward 500. It climbs naturally as you play, so this one comes with time.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The exact trigger is not confirmed publicly yet — the description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something — so check the cited sources for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The trigger is not confirmed publicly yet — it points at a strange, hidden event somewhere in Leonida — so check the cited sources before hunting for it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. The exact setup is not confirmed publicly yet — the description suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — so check the cited sources for the confirmed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Collect marked bills from jobs and pass them through your laundering contacts until the total hits $250,000 — the 100% checklist wants the same amount.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food, weapons and upgrades anywhere — the total adds up across every shop in Leonida.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; each one is a property purchase, and the trophy pops on the eighth.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Take vehicles you find to Scooter Bros and register them, one at a time, until you reach 10.
